remarks: Charming and beautifully updated Cape in Stamford's sought-after Glenbrook/Belltown neighborhood. This 3-bedroom, 3-bath home blends timeless character with modern comfort, featuring a welcoming front porch, formal living room with wood-burning fireplace, elegant dining room with French doors, and an open-concept kitchen with Corian counters, quartz-topped island, and new stainless-steel appliances. A cozy sunroom (or family room) with stained glass windows opens to the rear patio and level lawn, creating an ideal setting for everyday living and entertaining. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite offers vaulted ceilings, built-ins, a large sitting area, and gas fireplace. The primary suite opens to a small balcony for your morning coffee enjoyment. The 2 additional bedrooms are served by the hall bathroom and the loft completes the upper level which has new carpeting on the stairs, upper level hallway, loft and 2nd bedroom. Complete with main-level laundry, spacious basement with plenty of storage, and detached 2-car garage (new roof over the garage) which has the modern addition of a 220-amp charger this home is conveniently located near the train, shopping, parks, and schools.
